trigger_type: CRM-only criterion; native Deal timing optional
required_data: Relevant past opportunity, documented invitation/date, contact, company, owner, current preferences
associations: Current contact to company and relevant prior deal; native timing signal additionally needs the documented generation path
eligibility: Invitation covers this topic AND due date reached AND earlier timing reason still relevant AND current fit AND no exclusions
timing: Use the agreed date and time zone; a missed date requires owner judgment, not an invented freshness window
exclusions: Opt-out, refusal, active owner conversation, conflicting deal history, changed employer, expired or unclear invitation
owner: Previous opportunity owner or verified current owner
message_angle: Acknowledge the agreed timing and offer a relevant next step
enrollment_route: Active list (follow-up date is today or earlier) feeding the When added to any list automation, after owner review; or owner-reviewed manual enrollment

trigger: Earlier budget, scope, or capability obstacle has materially changed
required_data: Closed Lost reason, prior scope, evidence of changed obstacle, owner, contact preferences
associations: Current contact and company to the relevant lost deal; disambiguate multiple deals
eligibility: Prior obstacle is documented AND new evidence addresses that obstacle AND selected offer fits AND owner confirms relevance AND no exclusions
timing: Use the dated change where one exists; a client-chosen lookback since close is also valid when set in the segment
exclusions: Unresolved obstacle, explicit no-interest/hold, active opportunity, stale evidence, assumed budget from funding
message_angle: Explain what changed and how it relates to the earlier obstacle
enrollment_route: Active list or segment for the changed-obstacle criteria, owner-reviewed, then When added to any list or manual enrollment

trigger: Relevant initiative changes after a documented prior conversation
required_data: Signal type/date/details, earlier need or scope, current role, ownership, deal state, preferences
associations: Signal company to current contact; link relevant prior opportunity or activity explicitly
eligibility: Verified relevant signal AND documented prior topic AND current contact responsibility AND meaningful reason to restart AND no exclusions
timing: Propose a signal-specific freshness window; do not call old announcements recent
exclusions: Negative intent direction, unrelated event, unresolved refusal, account-only warmth, active conversation, wrong entity
message_angle: Connect the actual change to one prior issue without assuming a new problem
enrollment_route: Selected native signal under Audience > Signals with a Target companies segment, then owner-reviewed enrollment

trigger: Known relevant event participation or resource request
required_data: Contact identity, exact activity, date, resource/topic, stated preferences, owner
associations: Activity to named contact and correct company; distinguish registration from attendance
eligibility: Actual relevant contact activity AND suitable offer AND current fit AND permitted follow-up AND no exclusions
timing: Use actual activity date or requested timing; propose a short relevance window explicitly
exclusions: Only company news, anonymous visit or email open, opt-out, owner already handling the request
owner: Contact owner or person responsible for the event follow-up
message_angle: Continue the specific topic and fulfill any request before proposing another step
enrollment_route: Owner response for explicit requests; for eligible follow-up only, the When form is submitted or When page is viewed automation, or an active list

trigger_type: Contact job change plus prior relationship
trigger: Former champion starts at a new employer
required_data: Verified new employer/title, prior relationship evidence, new-account fit, owner, preferences
associations: Revalidate contact identity and new company; do not join through a stale company association
eligibility: Current role verified AND actual prior relationship AND new account fits AND topic relevant AND no exclusions
timing: Use the verified start date; choose a respectful proposed window
exclusions: Unverified employer, old email, confidential former-company details, refusal, wrong role, overlapping owner outreach
owner: Resolve old relationship owner and new account owner before enrollment
message_angle: Reconnect accurately and ask whether the topic is relevant in the new role
enrollment_route: Job started (or Job change by UserGems if installed) review queue, then owner-approved manual enrollment or the beta workflow action

trigger_type: Leadership signal plus CRM buying-group context
required_data: Verified appointment/departure/promotion, current buying group, relevant prior issue, owner, preferences
associations: Company to current role holder; old contact/deal association does not prove the new leader is involved
eligibility: Change verified AND new role relevant AND prior account topic still applicable AND no exclusions
timing: Use event date, allowing owner review of transition timing
exclusions: No verified successor, retirement used as an opportunity claim, assumed inherited budget, active conversation or hold
message_angle: Connect the responsibility to a relevant issue; do not invent familiarity with the new leader
enrollment_route: Account review task or queue; enroll manually only after contact verification

trigger: Documented renewal or planning window approaches
required_data: Actual renewal/planning date, prior topic, current provider/scope if documented, ownership, permitted contact timing
associations: Current contact and company linked to the relevant contract/deal/activity
eligibility: Verified relevant date AND legitimate prior context AND appropriate contact role AND permitted timing AND no exclusions
timing: Set a client-agreed lead time from the real date; never invent a renewal
exclusions: Date inferred from purchase age, active owner negotiation, opt-out/hold, scope outside selected offer
owner: Account or opportunity owner; distinguish customer service from prospecting
message_angle: Offer a useful perspective on the upcoming decision without assuming dissatisfaction
enrollment_route: Active list on the renewal or planning date feeding When added to any list; or owner-reviewed manual follow-up

trigger: Contact validity, sensitive event, or insufficient business relevance
required_data: Event evidence, record validity, account history, ownership, preferences
associations: Verify affected contact/company/entity before taking any next step
eligibility: Not an automatic outreach qualification; owner must resolve validity, fit, and relevance first
timing: Hold until material uncertainty is resolved; silence or elapsed time is insufficient
exclusions: Bounced/old email, departed contact, opt-out, unsupported distress assumptions, no offer connection
message_angle: No automated pitch from this cue alone
enrollment_route: Owner review or suppression list used as a segment exclusion; no automatic enrollment
